selection_evidence: C75E HEAD9_TASK_AND_HIDDEN_NI; this is a new independent model-seed cohort, not independent dataset replication.
H: A correction dimension selected before fitting as rank of the class-centered fixed teacher head (9 here) is non-inferior to full64 correction in the learned recursive compilation pipeline, on BOTH the preregistered accuracy and hidden-NMSE margins.

T.data_and_teacher: Exact C75E/C73E repaired Residual-MLP, fixed digits split, nested384 calibration, clipped Gaussian sigma .36; no held-out test evaluation.
T.selection_rule: Compute float64 SVD of teacher.head.weight after subtracting its class mean. Retain all singular vectors with singular value > largest*1e-10. Require rank9 for this preregistered architecture. No candidate sweep, calibration/validation accuracy selection or rescue dimension.
T.head_rank9: Project teacher residual onto the centered-head row space and retain frozen hierarchy in its complement; same float32 target construction as C75E. Adapt hierarchy then compile its outputs, no final teacher blend.
T.p64: Exact original canonical QR full64 correction pipeline, not a substituted direct teacher fit.
T.direct: Same4096-parameter TinyRes fitted directly to teacher targets; reference-validity control, not a rescue condition.
T.budget: Each hierarchy/final mapping4096 parameters; each fit600 updates, batch128,76800 draws; same init/minibatch offsets+715000/+716000/+717000 as C75E.
T.preflight: Synthetic gate checks; bridge73300 reproduces C75E head9/p64/direct teacher/data/stage-state hashes and metrics in the SAME execution environment. New verification74300 before any fresh cohort.
T.bootstrap_method: paired model-seed percentile95 using one common resampling index matrix

D.prerequisites: Complete/integrity-valid16 seeds; robust shifted-minus-clean teacher accuracy lower95>-20pp; p64-minus-teacher AND direct-minus-teacher accuracy lower95>-5pp.
D.primary_utility: head_rank9 minus p64 final validation accuracy lower95>-2pp
D.primary_hidden: geometric mean head_rank9/p64 hidden NMSE ratio upper95<1.25
D.states: For lower-bound criteria PASS if lower95>margin, FAIL if upper95<margin, otherwise UNCERTAIN. For max-ratio PASS if upper95<1.25, FAIL if lower95>1.25, otherwise UNCERTAIN.
D.joint_decision: If integrity incomplete STOP_INTEGRITY; if reference prerequisites not all PASS STOP_REFERENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED; otherwise both primary gates PASS -> C76R_CONFIRMATORY_PASS; either primary gate FAIL -> C76R_CONFIRMATORY_FAIL; otherwise C76R_CONFIRMATORY_UNCERTAIN.
D.secondary_descriptive: head-minus-teacher accuracy, head/direct accuracy, per-seed empirical primary-margin success, ideal oracle versus learned error decomposition; none changes primary outcome.
D.failure_rate_uncertainty: Report two-sided95 exact binomial interval for descriptive seed success count under a conditional iid-seed interpretation, rather than treating all-success percentile bootstrap[1,1] as certainty. This is not a population/dataset guarantee.

C: Ideal probability preservation does not guarantee learned mapping generalization.
Seed variation can invalidate the full reference, in which case no candidate confirmation is claimed.
Head9 may fail hidden-state NMSE despite retaining classification information.
Residual SVD8 also looked promising in C75E; no head9 optimality or superiority to every basis is hypothesized.
U: Only fixed digits, output boundary, repaired Residual-MLP, sigma .36 and384 calibration.
This confirms sufficient head-derived dimension, NOT the minimum useful dimension, not a universal64-to9 compression factor.
The theoretical rank bound is ordinary linear algebra and applies only to ideal correction and fixed affine head.
The implementation still computes full teacher residuals during calibration; no measured communication saving is claimed.
No inference-time teacher access, physical-hardware speed/memory/energy claim, CNN/SmallViT transfer or independent dataset validation.
Research branch remains separate from public main; confirmatory design does not replace independent scientific review.
